declaration.dataset_role: DEVELOPMENT; previously used during Strategy E research; not OOS and not live approval

portfolio.timeline: every valid XNYS session in the frozen dataset date range
portfolio.invalid_exit: UNRESOLVED_EXIT / INVALID_FOR_STANDARD_PNL; excluded from standard PnL without synthetic return

bootstrap.method: IID resampling with replacement of complete session portfolio returns

statistics.sharpe: sqrt(252) * arithmetic mean(all-session returns) / sample standard deviation(ddof=1); zero risk-free rate
statistics.sortino: sqrt(252) * arithmetic mean(all-session returns) / sqrt(mean(min(return,0)^2)); zero target
statistics.undefined_policy: null when denominator is zero/non-finite or fewer than two observations for Sharpe
statistics.maximum_drawdown: minimum(equity / running_peak - 1) on compounded equity beginning at 1

chronological_robustness.assignment: sort all XNYS evaluation sessions and split into four contiguous blocks with counts differing by at most one; never split by trades or outcomes
chronological_robustness.requirement: positive COST_10BP arithmetic mean session return in at least 3 of 4 blocks

gate.integrity: all frozen checksums and provenance, deterministic replay, and no look-ahead must pass
gate.net_economics: COST_10BP mean session portfolio return > 0 and trade-level profit factor > 1.0
gate.chronological_robustness: positive COST_10BP mean in at least 3 of 4 blocks
gate.fail: integrity and coverage pass, but mean session return <= 0 or profit factor <= 1.0
gate.inconclusive_promising: economics pass but bootstrap lower bound <= 0 or fewer than 3 positive blocks

diagnostics.liquidity_buckets: reuse frozen Research buckets when available; otherwise deterministic full-sample quantiles marked descriptive
diagnostics.break_even_cost: mean gross trade return in round-trip bp; diagnostic only

reporting.research_comparison: implementation delta only; the approximately 17bp matched H5 research lift is not a reproduction target

reproducibility.required: same input and frozen artifacts produce byte-equivalent canonical result content and identical digest
